name: Norma by Quality Clouds
description:
Norma connects Claude to your organization's coding standards, so AI-written code follows your rules from the first draft.

When Claude opens your repository, Norma detects the tech stack and serves the matching rulesets: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Vite, Supabase, Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PHP, and Adobe Commerce, plus SOLID architecture analysis. Each rule carries severity, fix guidance, and good/bad code examples, so the agent reads the standard before it writes a line.

Every file can then be verified with Livecheck: a deterministic check that gives the same file, same rules, same verdict every time. No model opinions, no drift between runs.

Norma also brings your repository's history into the session. Claude can read the open violations from your last full scan, each with the context to fix it, and work through them directly in your editor.

The part auditors care about: every task ends with a signed entry in an append-only compliance audit trail, recording which rules were verified, which violations were fixed, which were prevented, and which model did the work. When your security team asks what the AI changed and against which standards, the answer is already written.

Works with Claude Code, claude.ai, and any MCP client. Connect it to a linked repository for scoped rules, open issues, and the audit trail, or use it standalone for stack-aware checks on any file.

Built by Quality Clouds, the code governance company behind 9 years of platform quality data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Norma by Quality Clouds to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Norma by Quality Clouds to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.qualityclouds.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Norma by Quality Clouds MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Norma by Quality Clouds provides these MCP tools: get_open_issues, get_rules_for_ruleset, get_rulesets, link_repository, live_check, and register_applied_actions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Norma by Quality Clouds?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Norma by Quality Clouds in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Norma by Quality Clouds MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Norma by Quality Clouds requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Norma by Quality Clouds?

acceptedAnswer.text: Norma by Quality Clouds is developed by Quality Clouds. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
